ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a macro-level ratio of approximately 7:3 white-to-black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous regions on the lateral lobes. Low-intensity black pixels are concentrated in a central, jagged-edged cluster extending from the peduncle attachment point to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center; estimated pixel angle of 55 degrees with a well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with multiple pixel-level peaks and valleys. Notable larger notches on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the upper edges leading to distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, textured pixel clusters localized on the distal tips of both lobes, indicating probable barnacle attachment or dense scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark linear marks on the left lobe (two horizontal, one diagonal). One small dark mark on the interior region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear pigmentation disruptions on the left lobe and irregular serrations on the trailing edges indicating cumulative physical impact.
other_distinctive_markers: The boundary between the central black pigmentation and the white lobes is highly irregular and jagged.
